title: FOUR CHORDS #Shorts
description:
The same four chords - A minor, F, C, G - played in five different rooms:
the arrangement changes, the harmony never does. 100 BPM.

Made end to end in DAW Pro - an AI-native DAW for macOS. The performance, the
mix, the loudness pass and the picture are one pipeline; nothing was recorded off
a screen. Every instrument is the MuseScore General sound bank.

Original music, composed for this clip. Audio rendered offline at 48 kHz and
normalised to -14 LUFS integrated with a -1 dBTP ceiling.
